name: Inaka Power
known_for: Apparel for the Gym and Everyday

prices.note: Whole store (267 products): 5 regular-price short-sleeve tees, all $50 (Basics Cropped Tee, Day Off Cropped Tee, Off the Grid Cropped Tee, Anarchy Tee). Most tees, incl. the oversized Revive and Varsity tees ($50) and women's baby tees ($34), carry 'sale-25'/'sale-40'/'sale-60' tags and are excluded by the markdown rule even where compare-at equals price. Regular price = no variant with compare_at_price above price and no markdown tag (markdown, clearance, outlet, final, DiscountApplied, sale-NN, NN%, on-sale, sale, flash-sale, further reductions); campaign-eligibility tags with no compare-at price (e.g. '10th-anniversary-sale', 'cp:SeptEOSSale', 'DISCOUNT') are not treated as markdowns. Short-sleeve tees only: long-sleeve, tanks, stringers, polos, button-ups, jerseys, sweaters, packs and box sets excluded.

notes: Homepage meta: 'Inaka Power makes high-quality apparel for the gym and every day wear.' meta.json store address Sugar Land, Texas; ships_to 223 countries incl. US, CA, GB, AU.
